## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the existing React/Tailwind/shadcn conventions.
- [ ] New logic lives in `src/lib/` and has tests, or the change is covered by existing tests.
- [ ] Tool inputs are processed locally; no network calls or credentials were added.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with no new warnings.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes and generates SEO pages.
- [ ] I updated documentation or screenshots where needed.
